content.title: Webapp Phase 3: Rich detail (comments, blockages, hierarchy, history)

content.content:
Phase 3 scope (see .agentic/specs/webapp-spec.md and .agentic/specs/webapp-roadmap.md Phase 3):

BACKEND (7 endpoints):
1. GET /api/issues/:id/comments — list comments
2. POST /api/issues/:id/comments — add comment
3. PATCH /api/issues/:id/comments/:commentId — edit comment
4. DELETE /api/issues/:id/comments/:commentId — delete comment
5. GET /api/issues/:id/blockages — list blockages
6. POST /api/issues/:id/blockages — add blockages
7. PATCH /api/issues/:id/blockages/resolve — resolve blockages
8. DELETE /api/issues/:id/blockages — delete blockages
9. GET /api/issues/:id/history — return event log
10. GET /api/issues/next/:assignee — recommended next issue

FRONTEND:
11. CommentsSection (list, add, edit, delete comments)
12. BlockagesSection (blocked-by list, blocks list, add blockage dialog, resolve button)
13. SubIssuesSection (list children, create sub-issue button with pre-filled parentId)
14. IssueTree component for expandable sub-issues in list view
15. HistorySection (collapsible event timeline, read-only)
16. TagInput component (add tags by typing + enter, remove with x)
17. Parent selector in issue detail (set/change/clear parent)

VALIDATION CRITERIA:
- Can add, edit, delete comments
- Can add, resolve, delete blockages
- Sub-issues display in both list tree and detail views
- Can create sub-issues with parentId pre-filled
- History timeline displays correctly
- Tag input works (add/remove)
- Parent can be set, changed, and cleared
- Blockage indicators show on issue list rows

content.content:
Starting Phase 3 implementation. Plan:
1. Backend: comments routes, blockages routes, history route, next-issue route
2. Frontend types: Comment, Blockage, HistoryEvent
3. Frontend API layer: comments.ts, blockages.ts
4. Frontend hooks: use-comments.ts, use-blockages.ts
5. Frontend components: CommentsSection, BlockagesSection, SubIssuesSection, IssueTree, HistorySection, TagInput, Parent selector
6. Update IssueDetailPage and IssueList with new sections and tree view

Phase 3 implementation complete. All TypeScript compiles and frontend builds cleanly.

**Backend (6 new route files/endpoints):**
- server/routes/comments.ts — GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE for comments
- server/routes/blockages.ts — GET/POST/PATCH resolve/DELETE for blockages
- Added GET /api/issues/:id/history and GET /api/issues/next/:assignee to issues routes
- Registered all new routes in server/index.ts

**Frontend types:**
- Added Comment, BlockageEntry, BlockageInfo, HistoryEvent, NextIssueResult types

**Frontend API layer:**
- api/comments.ts — list, add, update, delete
- api/blockages.ts — list, add, resolve, delete
- Extended api/issues.ts with history() and next()

**Frontend hooks:**
- hooks/use-comments.ts — useComments, useAddComment, useUpdateComment, useDeleteComment
- hooks/use-blockages.ts — useBlockages, useAddBlockage, useResolveBlockage, useDeleteBlockage

**Frontend components (6 new):**
- CommentsSection — list/add/edit/delete comments with inline editing and delete confirmation
- BlockagesSection — blocked-by list, blocks list, add blockage dialog with search, resolve/delete buttons
- SubIssuesSection — children list, create sub-issue with pre-filled parentId
- HistorySection — collapsible timeline with event icons and summaries
- TagInput — type+enter to add tags, x to remove, backspace support
- ParentSelector — search/select to set parent, clear parent, navigate to parent
- IssueTree — recursive expandable sub-issues with chevrons and indentation

**Updated existing components:**
- IssueDetailPage — integrated all new sections (tags with TagInput, parent selector, blockages, sub-issues, comments, history)
- IssueList — now uses IssueTree for expandable sub-issues

**Note:** Blockage indicators on issue list rows require per-issue API calls which is expensive. The tree view loads blockages only when expanded. Full blockage detail is available on the issue detail page. This is a reasonable v1 tradeoff.
